pairs.ask: Where To Sell The Setup First: Lemon Squeezy Or Gumroad? (gumroad.com/pricing; lemonsqueezy.com/pricing)

optionA.label: Lemon Squeezy
optionA.desc: 5% + $0.50 per sale, subscriptions and license keys included, merchant of record, no monthly fee.

optionB.label: Gumroad
optionB.desc: 10% + $0.50 direct, 30% via Discover marketplace, merchant of record, no monthly fee.

pairs.ask: Fee Tradeoff: Lower Cut With Lemon Squeezy, Or Gumroad Discover Reach?

optionA.label: Take The Lower Cut
optionA.desc: Lemon Squeezy at 5% + $0.50 keeps more of each sale for the first paid test.

optionB.label: Pay For Discover Reach
optionB.desc: Gumroad Discover at 30% may bring buyers you would not find alone.

pairs.ask: Subscriptions For The Monthly Pilot Fee: Built-In On Lemon Squeezy, Or Stripe Later?

optionA.label: Use Lemon Squeezy Subs
optionA.desc: Subscriptions are included on Lemon Squeezy pricing page; fits $250/mo pilot fee.

optionB.label: Add Stripe Later
optionB.desc: Stripe US cards are 2.9% + 30c (stripe.com/pricing); more control, more setup.

pairs.ask: License Keys For A Template Kit: Lemon Squeezy License Keys, Or Manual Delivery?

optionA.label: License Keys Built In
optionA.desc: Lemon Squeezy lists license keys on pricing; good if a Self-Serve tier ships later.

optionB.label: Manual Delivery First
optionB.desc: Email a zip after payment until volume needs keys.

pairs.ask: Sales Tax Handling: Rely On Merchant Of Record, Or Self-Collect With Stripe Tax?

optionA.label: Merchant Of Record
optionA.desc: Both Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy handle sales tax as MoR (their pricing pages).

optionB.label: Self With Stripe Tax
optionB.desc: More control, more compliance work before the first paid pilot.

pairs.ask: First Paid Test Channel: Direct Link Only, Or Also List On Gumroad Discover?

optionA.label: Direct Link Only
optionA.desc: Warm intros from the construction network; no Discover fee.

optionB.label: Also List On Discover
optionB.desc: Pay up to 30% for marketplace exposure (gumroad.com/pricing).

pairs.ask: Landing Page For The Waitlist: Carrd Pro Standard ($19/yr) Or GitHub Pages Free? (carrd.co/pro)

optionA.label: Carrd Pro Standard
optionA.desc: $19/yr with custom domain and forms; cheapest polished waitlist.

optionB.label: GitHub Pages Free
optionB.desc: Static page is fine for a waitlist with no payments (Pages limits apply).

pairs.ask: Waitlist Form: Free Tally Or Tally Pro (EUR 20/mo)? (tally.so/pricing)

optionA.label: Free Tally
optionA.desc: Unlimited submissions on free; enough for 10 warm conversations.

optionB.label: Tally Pro
optionB.desc: EUR 20/mo if you need paid features before the pilot fills.

pairs.ask: Show The Founding Price On The Landing Page Up Front, Or Hide Until A Call?

optionA.label: Show Price Up Front
optionA.desc: Plan recommends price on the waitlist page so tire-kickers self-select.

optionB.label: Hide Until A Call
optionB.desc: Talk first; price after the demo on your phone.

pairs.ask: Refund And Cancel Terms: One-Tap Cancel Like Competitors Complain About Missing, Or Manual Email Only?

optionA.label: One-Tap Cancel
optionA.desc: Sintra and Lindy complaints cite refund fights; clear cancel is a selling point.

optionB.label: Email Cancel Only
optionB.desc: Simpler to start; write the policy before taking money.

pairs.ask: Before Taking Money: Private Login Ready, Or Take Deposits On Public Pages?

optionA.label: Private Login First
optionA.desc: GitHub Pages terms bar running a commercial SaaS; plan says build auth before money.

optionB.label: Deposit On Public Page
optionB.desc: Faster test; higher risk of public data and Pages terms issues.

pairs.ask: Platform Resale Check: Written Answer From The Provider Before Any Paid Pilot, Or Proceed On Public Terms Alone?

optionA.label: Get It In Writing
optionA.desc: Enterprise terms bar selling or time-sharing; ask which model is allowed first.

optionB.label: Proceed On Public Terms
optionB.desc: Client-owns-the-account path may fit permitted-user language; still a judgment call.

pairs.ask: Sell Path If Platform Blocks Resale: Client Owns The Account, Or Build A Bundled API App?

optionA.label: Client Owns The Account
optionA.desc: Client buys the plan; Max sets up as outside consultant (permitted user language).

optionB.label: Build On The API
optionB.desc: Bundled Service path; bigger build before the first sale.

pairs.ask: Checkout Branding: Keep Checkout On Lemon Squeezy Or Gumroad Hosted Page, Or Custom Domain Checkout?

optionA.label: Hosted Checkout Page
optionA.desc: Ship faster; MoR page is fine for 3 founding pilots.

optionB.label: Custom Domain Checkout
optionB.desc: Looks more premium; more setup before the first test.

pairs.ask: First Money Product: Done-For-You Setup Fee Plus Monthly, Or Template Kit One-Time?

optionA.label: Setup Plus Monthly
optionA.desc: Plan: $750 setup + $250/mo Estimate for 3 lanes, 60 days.

optionB.label: Template Kit One-Time
optionB.desc: Sell files only after pilots prove the offer; lower support load.

pairs.ask: Payment For Setup Fee: Full Up Front, Or Split Setup Across Two Months?

optionA.label: Full Up Front
optionA.desc: Clearest cash for the 60-day pilot; matches ATI Lab-style setup fees.

optionB.label: Split Across Two Months
optionB.desc: Easier yes for small crews; more dunning work.

pairs.ask: Payout Currency And Bank: US Stripe Or MoR Payouts Only For Now?

optionA.label: MoR Payouts Only
optionA.desc: Lemon Squeezy or Gumroad pay you; no Stripe account yet.

optionB.label: Add Stripe In Parallel
optionB.desc: Needed if you leave MoR later; 2.9% + 30c US cards.

pairs.ask: Pilot Cap: Hard Cap At 3 Founding Spots, Or Soft Waitlist With No Cap?

optionA.label: Hard Cap Of Three
optionA.desc: Plan: Max's time does not scale; productize after 3.

optionB.label: Soft Waitlist
optionB.desc: Collect interest now; decide cap after 10 conversations.

pairs.ask: Demo Asset Before Checkout: iPhone Screen Recording, Or Live Screenshare Only? (support.apple.com screen record)

optionA.label: Phone Screen Recording
optionA.desc: One clip: Morning Report, one swipe, one vote; easy to text.

optionB.label: Live Screenshare Only
optionB.desc: More personal; harder to scale across 10 warm intros.

pairs.ask: After First Sale Ops: Monitor Missed Morning Reports Per Client, Or Manual Check-Ins Only?

optionA.label: Automated Missed-Report Watch
optionA.desc: Plan sec. 7: monitoring protects the daily-rhythm promise.

optionB.label: Weekly Manual Check-Ins
optionB.desc: Enough for 3 pilots; automate after productize.
